questions.q: What does an RMAN channel actually do?
options: It's a scheduled job that triggers backups automatically
It's a connection to a specific device (disk or tape) that performs the actual backup/restore I/O
It's a synonym for the target database
It's the network connection between RMAN and the recovery catalog only
questions.explain: RMAN allocates one or more channels to perform the read/write I/O against disk or tape.

questions.q: By default, where does RMAN store metadata about the backups it has taken?
options: In a mandatory separate recovery catalog database
It doesn't store any metadata by default
In a flat text file on the OS
In the target database's own control file
questions.explain: The control file is the default metadata store, bounded by CONTROL_FILE_RECORD_KEEP_TIME.

questions.q: What is a real advantage of using a recovery catalog over relying only on the control file?
options: Metadata survives even if the target database's control file is lost, and one catalog can track many target databases centrally
It's required before RMAN can take any backup at all
It automatically encrypts all backups
It eliminates the need for channels
questions.explain: A recovery catalog is a separate, durable metadata store that isn't bounded by control-file retention and can serve multiple databases.

questions.q: What does CONFIGURE BACKUP OPTIMIZATION ON actually change about RMAN's behavior?
options: It disables the recovery catalog
RMAN skips re-backing-up files it can tell haven't changed since a previous backup that satisfies the retention policy
It forces every backup to run on tape instead of disk
It compresses every backup automatically
questions.explain: Backup optimization speeds up repeat backups by skipping unchanged files, rather than changing storage medium or compression.

questions.q: What does CONFIGURE CONTROLFILE AUTOBACKUP ON provide?
options: Automatic registration with the recovery catalog
Automatic allocation of channels for every session
Automatic backup of the control file and spfile after every backup and significant structural change, so a lost control file can still be restored
Automatic deletion of obsolete backups
questions.explain: Controlfile autobackup protects against total control file loss by keeping an automatic, current copy available to restore from.
